summary: VOYARA Travel: ran full backend pytest suite (20/20 PASS) covering health, auth (register/login/me/logout/wrong-password), admin RBAC (admin OK, customer 403 on /leads and /analytics/summary), leads CRUD (newsletter/enquiry/contact) with persistence verified via admin /leads and /me/trips, blog listing (12+ seeded articles)/category filter/detail with related/unknown-slug 404, analytics track + summary totals and by_event, dashboard saved toggle, preferences update + persistence, and /me/trips auth guard. Frontend Playwright coverage: home loads with hero + search, mobile menu toggle present, Plan My Trip modal opens & submits (success toast), home + footer newsletter work, Destinations search/filter + card click opens detail (/destinations/santorini), Blog list shows 11 cards and click opens article page, Offers 'View offer' opens Plan modal, Contact form submits successfully, Signup creates account and redirects to /dashboard, all 5 Dashboard tabs render (trips, destinations, offers, preferences, account), Preferences save works, Logout clears session, Admin login redirects to /admin and renders stat cards + Event Analytics bar chart + CRM Leads tab.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> (text wrapped in instrumentation span). Non-blocking but produces console noise on every Plan Trip / Contact select render. Fix by ensuring option children are plain strings.

action_items: The review-request assumed test IDs do not match actual implementation; align docs or ids. Mismatches found: signup fields are 'signup-firstname'/'signup-lastname' (not 'signup-first-name'/'signup-last-name'); Dashboard saved tabs are 'dashboard-tab-destinations' and 'dashboard-tab-offers' (not '...-saved-destinations'/'...-saved-offers'); Admin stat cards use 'stat-registered-users|newsletter-sign-ups|enquiries|tracked-events' and leads container is 'admin-leads' (no 'admin-stat-events'/'admin-leads-table'/'admin-events-chart').
Silence React hydration warning about <span> inside <option> in TripPlannerModal and ContactPage selects (ensure plain string children).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 575 lines - acceptable but approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into routers (auth/leads/blog/analytics/dashboard) soon.

login_attempts lockout logic increments count on every failure but never clears locked_until when count<5, so a user can be partially locked even before reaching 5; functionally OK since gate is count>=5 but worth documenting.
Analytics /track endpoint is unauthenticated and unrate-limited - potential abuse vector for seeding analytics.
/me/saved doesn't validate item_id against known destinations/offers - any arbitrary string can be saved.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows after id correction

test_credentials: admin@voyaratravel.com / Voyara2026! (seeded admin). Test customers created on-the-fly with TEST_* prefix.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_ prefixed users/leads created during pytest run (not cleaned up intentionally - admin can filter by TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses pytest-xdist (configured in /app/backend/pytest.ini). All 20 tests pass. Known data-testid differences from original brief are documented in action_items - update test scripts accordingly, DO NOT rename the ids in app code without checking usage.
